title: NexTalk blind voice-clone test set
description: A blind listening test for cross-lingual (C->EN) voice cloning. Samples are renamed to opaque blind ids before grading so a grader never knows which vendor produced a clip; the vendor labels live only in voice_candidates and are joined back after the scores are recorded. No secret fields: credentials never appear in this file (T-01-15).

test_set_id.description: Stable id for this test set, e.g. clone-2026-09.

created_at.description: Date the sample set was frozen (ISO 8601).

environment.description: Where the samples were rendered and auditioned: machine, output device, connection. A clone score without its environment is not evidence.

utterances.description: The fixed text every candidate voice must speak. Identical text across candidates is what makes the comparison blind and fair.

text_zh.description: The Chinese source line the user says (the clone input's meaning).

text_en.description: The English line the cloned voice must speak. Cross-lingual cloning quality is the product's core value, so the pair must not be a literal word-for-word gloss.

duration_hint.description: Target spoken duration; keeps the set aligned with the STT protocol's clip lengths.

register.description: Optional label used when reporting which register a vendor wins.

voice_candidates.description: One entry per cloned voice under test. THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE VENDOR LABELS APPEAR - it must never be handed to a grader.

vendor.description: Vendor name from the STACK.md TTS shortlist, e.g. minimax | cartesia | fish | elevenlabs.

voice_id.description: The vendor-side clone / voice identifier the sample was rendered with.

sample_path.description: Path to the rendered sample for this utterance, relative to the test-set root. Never a URL with an embedded key.

utterance_id.description: The utterance this sample renders; pair it with sample_path when one file holds a single utterance.

graders.description: Who listens and scores. Each grader sees only blind ids.

grader_id.description: Opaque grader id - no names, so a score cannot be attributed to a person in the committed file.

blind_ids.description: The opaque ids this grader will score. A blind id maps to exactly one (voice_candidate, utterance) pair.

grading_sheet.description: What actually reaches the grader. It carries blind ids only - no vendor labels anywhere in this object.

blind_map.description: blind id -> {voice_index, utterance_id}. The join key back to voice_candidates lives here, in the file the grader does NOT hold.

scale.description: The rubric a grader scores each blind sample on. Keep the integers small enough to use without a legend.

scores.description: Filled in during grading: one row per (grader, blind id). Vendor labels are joined back afterwards.
